exchanges: You take the doorway, I'll take the other doorway. There is only one doorway, isn't there.
We'll share it. Shoulder to shoulder. Nothing gets past two of us and a stuck hinge.
Sometimes I wonder about life in the back row. The view. The safety. The not being bitten.
I tried it once, {ally}. My hands kept reaching for something to block. Never again.
On a scale of one to ten, how upset would you be if I stood in front of that thing?
Standing in front of things is your entire job. Just stop apologizing mid-bandage, it ruins my stitching.
You've patched this same shoulder four times today. I counted.
I'm considering installing a hinge there. Save us both the ceremony.
Whatever you're aiming at is three inches from my ear.
Three inches is a generous margin. Most days you get one.
It must be peaceful back there.
Very. I can hear everything that's about to happen to you.
The back of my neck got warm during that last spell. Just letting you know.
Warm is the system working. Crispy is the complaint threshold.
What's the plan if something gets past me and reaches you?
Screaming, then a spell. The order is non-negotiable.
Stay behind my shoulder. Things with teeth go for the closest snack.
Behind your shoulder is where the boring happens. I'll take my chances at tooth range.
You ran past me again. The formation has exactly one rule.
And I bend it lovingly every floor, because the enemy is over there and I am not.
Whatever you did back there, my arms stopped being tired. I don't ask questions, but thank you.
Wise policy. The explanation has never once helped anyone.
Do you ever feel bad, hanging back while I take every hit?
Terribly. I cope by making you slightly better at taking them.
Be honest. Do you ever just not heal someone for a moment? As a lesson?
A moment is a lesson. Two moments is a grudge. I keep strictly to lessons.
Floor {depth}, and not one of them has said thank you.
They thank us by surviving. Worst currency in the kingdom.
You're the only one who never needs patching. I almost miss you.
That's the nicest threat I've had all week.
If you ever do get hurt back here, yell in a clear, distinct tone. I triage by volume.
Understood. I've been practicing a very dignified yelp.
Your mana comes back if you rest. My patience does not. Pace yourself.
I pace myself perfectly. One enormous spell, then a tasteful collapse.
You're pale, and nothing has hit you yet.
The big spells take something out of you. Mostly the part that holds me upright.
Every wound on you is on the front. Brave, I'll grant. Also a billing nightmare.
Front wounds are honest wounds. Bill me.
What if — and stay with me, {ally} — you dodged?
Dodging is admitting the enemy gets a say.
You make them faster, I put them back together. We're an assembly line with feelings.
An efficient one. They barely have time to be ungrateful between us.
Does anyone thank you? They never thank me.
Constantly. I make their numbers go up. You merely save their lives.
Called it. Left eye, forty paces.
You called it after it landed. I heard you call it.
The back row is getting crowded. One of us should stand slightly more to the back.
Seniority says the rear is mine. You may have the prestigious slightly-forward position.
I have to account for every shot I loose. What do spells cost you?
A nap, a headache, and three years of my youth per casting. Magic invoices later.
Your last spell parted my hair, and I was standing behind you.
Power radiates. I can't be held responsible for which direction.
You stood directly between me and the target again.
The target and I had something to settle. Closely.
From back here, your fighting style looks like falling down stairs on purpose.
From up close, yours looks like polite littering. We all have our craft.
Whatever you did, I haven't missed since breakfast.
That one wasn't me. That was all you. Mine kicks in after lunch.
You watch everyone's backs. Who watches yours?
You do, from a hundred feet away. I think about that more than I say.
You named the new spell after yourself, didn't you.
It's called attribution. When it misfires, I'm renaming it after you.
Do you ever miss the days when we knew one spell and it barely worked?
Every day. It fizzled beautifully, and nobody expected anything of us.
Kindly stop standing where I'm about to put the explosion.
Put the explosion where I'm not. I was there first.
How do you stand it? Being close enough to smell them?
The smell is information. You learn a lot about a slime in the last six inches.
Whatever you did back there doubled my spell. I want it permanently.
Then keep me alive. The effect wears off dramatically when I'm unconscious.
Your job confuses me. You don't hit things, you don't mend things. What do you do?
You know that feeling when everything goes slightly right? That's me. I'm the feeling.
Race you to the next thing with teeth.
Loser takes the thing after it, which is always bigger. So I win either way — wait.
My count is eleven today. Yours?
Twelve, but who's counting. Me. I am. It's twelve.
I felt unstoppable for ten glorious seconds back there. Then extremely stoppable. Explain.
It wears off. That's the business model.
You just stand there while I do all the hitting.
I stand there meaningfully. You haven't lost once while I was standing there, {ally}.
No healer today. Just us and the power of positive thinking.
Positivity is load-bearing. Nobody notices until the ceiling is on them.
If we both buff the same person, do they get twice as brave or just insufferable?
We did it to the tank once. They challenged a locked door to a duel and lost on points.
Your skeleton has been staring at me all morning.
He admires you. You're the reason his department gets no new hires.
I bless the living and bury the dead, and I genuinely don't know which form your friends go under.
File them as returning staff. They love the recognition.
If you die down here, do I heal you or onboard you?
Heal me, obviously. Management is a living position.
Chew. The ration has layers. I laminated that jerky by hand.
Tastes better fast. Speed is a seasoning.
You ate the emergency soup. The soup labeled 'emergency.'
I was hungry. Hunger is an emergency. The label and I agreed.
Your diet is monster meat and whatever falls in your beard. I'm staging an intervention.
The beard is the pantry. Intervene and lose the hand.
I'm writing a ballad about you. The trouble is your verses are all rests.
*conducts an invisible orchestra through four bars of silence, then bows*
Give me one note. Just one. I'll transcribe it and we'll call it a duet.
*opens his mouth wide, plucks out an invisible note, polishes it, and pockets it unsung*
You're the finest audience I've ever had. You never sing along.
*wipes away a single invisible tear and applauds without making a sound*
The bees have concerns about this floor. Mostly the airflow. Some of it personal.
The mosses share them. Nobody down here has ever once consulted the mosses.
I offered the swarm overtime to scout ahead. They're holding out for better flowers.
There's a lichen two corridors back. Tell them it's no rose, but it's punctual.
Do your mosses ever talk back?
Do your bees ever stop?
Regulation says we clear corners in pairs. I'll take the left.
Take both, friend. I'll stand in the middle and inspire.
Your armor is blinding me. Did you polish it again?
Polish? No. That's inner virtue surfacing. It does that.
I follow the code because it works. Why do you follow it?
Because it looks magnificent on me. We arrive at the same place.
Lovely fight back there. Shame about how fair it was.
Fairness is the point. The wicked deserve to see justice coming.
I checked that chest for traps. Also for contents. It's been handled.
Handled into your pockets, you mean. I'll be blessing the party ledger tonight.
You glow in the dark. Do you know what that does to a stealth approach?
It announces that righteousness has arrived. You're welcome.
No weapons, no armor, no yelling. How do you even fight?
Calmly. Try it sometime. Enemies find it far more upsetting.
I rage so hard I forget my own name. What's your secret?
I remember mine very precisely. That's the entire technique.
Arm wrestle. Right now. Winner carries the gold.
I carry nothing. Possessions cloud the spirit. Best of three, though.
Report. What did you see down that corridor?
*mimes a staircase, then an enormous spider, then climbs the invisible staircase at remarkable speed*
Protocol requires a verbal all-clear. Can you give me anything?
*salutes crisply, fills out an invisible form in triplicate, and hands it over*
I'll admit it. You're the only one who never argues with my orders.
*drags over an invisible soapbox, steps onto it, and says absolutely nothing at length*
Could you raise me a lab assistant? Something that holds beakers and doesn't gossip?
All of mine gossip. No lips, and somehow worse at keeping secrets.
You did first aid on yourself again. There is an entire me for that.
I hate to be a bother. Also, my bandaging is more luminous.
Hold still. You're bleeding on your own radiance.
It's ambient virtue, and it's machine washable.
One day off. No miracles, no triage, just a chair.
I'll cover for you. How hard can healing be? I radiate wellness recreationally.
That rampage had a time signature. Did you know you rage in three-four?
I don't know what that means, but I want it angrier.
I need a rhyme for 'headbutt.'
'Dead, but.' As in, he's dead, but the wall got worse.
Your battle cry — what is it, actually? Words? A name?
Started as a grocery list. Now it's tradition.
I need honey for the glaze. What are the bees asking?
Two flower beds and a formal apology about the lavender. They remember the lavender.
Tonight is roast rat with a honey crust. Don't tell the swarm what it's for.
They know. They always know. Serve it indoors and don't make eye contact with the scouts.
Is the swarm union or freelance?
Seasonal contractors with strong opinions. Why, is the kitchen hiring?
Everything you raise was supposed to be soil by now. You're robbing my compost.
Borrowing. It all decomposes eventually. I just add a layover.
The mosses won't grow where your skeletons walk.
Professional courtesy. They're waiting for the moss to pass. Mostly.
Moss grows even down here, you know. Encouraging.
So does death. Mine just keeps better hours.
That goblin walked into my arrow. All according to plan.
Funny. The plan I watched involved you apologizing to a wall.
I had eyes on that chest the whole time. I was letting you open it.
And I'd emptied it a room earlier. We're both excellent liars.
I never miss. Arrows that miss are scouting.
Naturally. And the things in my pockets are evidence I'm safekeeping.
Your fireball took my shot, my target, and most of my eyebrows.
It was pointed away from all friends at the moment of casting. Eyebrows travel at their own risk.
I aim. You wave your arms and the room ends. It feels unearned.
Twelve years of study so I could wave my arms. It is extremely earned.
One quiet shot, one target, no fuss. That's craftsmanship.
Adorable. I deleted a corridor this morning.
Where is your armor? We're {depth} floors down and you're in trousers.
Sold it. It was slowing down the parts of me that win fights. All of the parts.
There are protocols for breaching a door.
Agreed. My forehead. Protocol complete.
You charged before my signal again.
Your signal takes forever. The enemy was just standing there, completely uncharged-at.
I'm composing an epic about your healing. Working title, 'Hold Still, You Idiot.'
Finally, art that reflects my clinical experience.
Every hero gets a verse. You get the chorus, since you're in every fight.
Make the chorus a sigh. One long sigh. That's accurate.
You saved my life twice today. What rhymes with 'eternally indebted'?
'Regularly regretted.' Now hold still.
Is this moss edible?
That's Gerald. We've discussed this. You don't ask whether Gerald is edible.
I foraged these mushrooms. Rate them for soup.
Two are friends of mine, and the speckled one screams when boiled. Your call, as a professional.
No staff, no wand, no focus crystal. What channels your power?
Breakfast, and a clear conscience.
I could enchant your fists. Imagine the sparks.
My fists are at peace with their current settings.
Doesn't it hurt, punching a skeleton?
Pain is a teacher. The skeleton and I are classmates.
Stop narrating my heists in real time. The verse about the lockpick had witnesses.
Art demands an audience. Crime is just art that runs.
Half the loot is mine, and so is half of whatever that song earns.
You can't steal royalties. ...You can, can't you. You already have.
I work best unseen, unheard, and unsung. You threaten all three.
Unsung? Darling, you're getting a trilogy whether you attend or not.
The fireball clause is clear. No casting within thirty feet of the swarm.
I signed nothing. Although the small print did sting, now that you mention it.
Smoke calms them. Explosions do the opposite. Today we learned that together.
In my defense, nobody briefed the explosion.
The hive calls you 'the warm one.' It is not a compliment.
I'll take it. Last week I was 'the reason we live in a bucket now.'
My light is consecrated. Your minions can't even look at me.
Nobody can look at you. That's not holiness, that's wattage.
Have you considered redemption? It comes with benefits.
I tried it once. The skeletons staged a walkout. I'm needed.
When you fall, I will personally see you given a blessed burial.
Sweet of you. I've arranged to be picked up afterward. Don't linger.
One bowl of rice and you punch through walls. Explain it to me slowly, as a recipe.
Gratitude, mostly. And exactly enough rice.
My soup heals wounds. What does inner peace do, nutritionally?
Fewer wounds to soup. We're colleagues, really.
Garlic. Or have you renounced flavor as well?
We renounce weapons, not garlic. Double the garlic. The vow insists.
Finally, a partner who appreciates silence. Watch the lock. Tap twice if there's trouble.
*taps twice immediately, then mimes an enormous something looming in the doorway behind them*
You'd make a brilliant burglar. No alarm could hear you. Ever consider a career change?
*mimes climbing out of an invisible box, considers the open air, then locks himself back inside*
The split is sixty-forty, and you can't argue. That's why I love working with you.
*counts invisible coins, weighs the two piles, and silently slides one across until they match*
